title: Mixed Event — You Are My Hero!

meta.Outline: On one of his runs, Tsukasa rescues and befriends a stranded cat. At the same time, a cat-themed carnival has arrived in Shibuya.

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
A clear blue sky... What a beautifully sunny day!
I couldn't have asked for better running conditions!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I need to keep building up my stamina in order to get the most out of my training at Morinomiya.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I had quite a lot of confidence in my endurance, but I still pale in comparison to the boys enrolled there.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I have to keep trying, and build the proficiency to properly play any role I am given.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I'll finish this leg and keep going all out during my next exercise...!

<Let's go, Tsukasa!
You can do it, Tsukasa♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, if it isn't Miku!
What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, the others and I are spending today cheering on everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We know you guys all work really hard studying and practicing during your days off, so we're gonna give you lots of support☆>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So! Let's go, Tsukasa♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah! Now I understand.
Thank you, Miku. I'm feeling more motivated already!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Really?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I was actually just about to wrap up my run, but I'm thinking about doing an extra lap now...
M-Meow...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, Tsukasa, did you hear that just now?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You heard it as well? What do you think it—
Meowww...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <There it is again! It sounds like...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, a cat...
But it doesn't sound all that well...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What if it's in trouble...?
We need to find it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Right! Let's see... I think it might be over there!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's go!
se_run_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This seems like the right spot...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Tsukasa! Tsukasa! Look at the pond over there!>

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh no...
He's gotten himself stuck on one of the stepping stones...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<He looks so scared...
Please, Tsukasa, you gotta save him!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's the plan!
I just need to find a place where I can jump close enough to him...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, I'm not seeing any good spots. And the stone he's on is too small for me to jump to directly. I'd surely scare him if I were to slip and fall in...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Isn't there any other way...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I know! What if you showed him what to do?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Showed him?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah! You can show him what he's gotta do to get back to land safely!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <KAITO and the others model stuff for me all the time when we're practicing☆>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. That may be worth a try...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I don't know if I'll succeed...
But I may be able to help him if I put my acting skills on full display!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You there, cat!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Listen up. Watch what I'm about to do.
You need to jump! Like...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This!!!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <He's tilting his head...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He looks confused...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But he might understand if I keep trying.
So, let me try that again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Watch. Plant your legs like this, make sure you have a good footing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And jump! Like this...!

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't worry! You can do it...!

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Me-Meow...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, I think he's trying to jump now!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's it! We can try jumping together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ready?! One, two...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Three!!!

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You did it!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<That was amazing!
It was so cool how you flew up and stuck the landing☆>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that was a wonderful display of courage! Umm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nyantaro!!

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, his name is Nyantaro☆>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm so glad that you're smiling now, Nyantaro♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Actually, I just decided to name him that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What's this shape on your back...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's a star! I couldn't tell earlier since you were too far away... That's incredible, Nyantaro!

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow...
se_event_myhero_2025_002

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <There he goes...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, he lost interest rather quickly...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, as short as that interaction was, we became friends by accomplishing something together. Let us wish him the best in life!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Be strong, Nyantaro!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Bye bye!>

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. He replied back♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and he sounded incredibly happy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, now that Nyantaro is safely back on dry land, we should get back to what we were doing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Right! I'm gonna cheer you on like crazy☆>
Several days later

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This way, Mizuki!
I'm starting to see the Ferris wheel!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The gondolas are supposed to be really cute, but we still can't see them very well from this far... We gotta get closer...!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're walking so fast, Airi!
Also, you seem way too excited today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course I'm excited! I mean, today...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We get to visit a cat-themed carnival!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just the thought of going to a carnival is fun, but this one's all about cats...! It's like a dream come true for me, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: From what we saw on social media, the Ferris wheel and all their other attractions have cats all over them. Which means...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's guaranteed to be adorable...!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I see what you mean!
And I know just how much you love cats, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Exactly!
As much as I want to pet or hold real ones, I can't...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's why I absolutely have to check out this carnival. I'll get to be around cats with none of the health risks, so it's going to be like paradise...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's have as much fun as we can today♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! The carnival should be just through this park...
Heeeeeeey!!!

Nyantarooooooo!!!!!
Where are yoooou?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That sounds like...
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nyantaro! Where are you?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hmm... No sign of him here, either...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not a trace... Since that day, I've had a chance to see him each time I've come to do a run. What could've happened to him...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Does he not want any dried sardines today...?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't know. I just hope he isn't going hungry...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, Tsukasa!
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Akiyama?
Oh, and if it isn't Airi Momoi! Long time no see!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you two heading somewhere together?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Again, why do you always call me by my full name?! No, I keep responding the same way... It's like some sort of weird reflex now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha...
We were on our way to check out a carnival that's in Shibuya right now. It's supposed to be all cat themed and really cute!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, Tsukasa, what were you doing just now?
We heard you shouting from way over there...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, about that... I'm looking for Nyantaro.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nyantaro?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's a stray cat I met while doing my usual run here. We became friends after I helped him out of a bind.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've been seeing him here at the park each day and getting to know him better by giving him some dried sardines...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But he isn't at our usual spot today.
In fact, I can't find him anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So that's what's going on...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But stray cats come and go all the time.
He might be somewhere else today, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, cats are pretty independent.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, but I'm worried that he isn't getting enough to eat...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see...
I also love cats, so I understand your concern.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why don't we help him look before we head over to the carnival, Mizuki? We still have some time before it opens.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, works for me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're going to help?! Thank you both very much...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, since I've already searched this area, let's look over that wa—
Huh? Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?
se_walk_women_003_3

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene?! What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me? I was just getting some running in...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh! Morning, Kusanagi!
What a coincidence!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
M-Momoi? Akiyama...?
What are you two doing here with Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We're gonna help him look for a cat!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
He's called Nyantaro...
Did you happen to see him, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Nyantaro...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In that case, I'll help you guys look for him. I was actually just about to take a break.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
By the way, what kind of cat should I be looking for?
Knowing his breed or the color of his fur would help...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene, your help is much appreciated...!
And as it so happens, he has a wonderful defining characteristic!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Believe it or not, he carries a star upon his back...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A star?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right. On the left side of his back is a patch of fur that looks uncannily like a star. As for the color of his fur, he's an orange and white tabby.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: An orange and white tabby with a star on his back...? That sounds like...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Does that mean you've seen him, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's right there.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
N-Nyantaro...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, this is him...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow, he really does have a star on his back! Haha. Talk about great timing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're late! I was worried sick!
I brought you some more sardines toda—
se_walk_men_003_1
Oh, Nyantaro, are these new friends of yours...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow!

Haha. That explains it.
I was wondering where you've been going on walks lately. You were seeing your friends.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
P-Pardon me...
But you are...?

Ah, this is my cat...
I'm Nyantaro's owner.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: His...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: His owner...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, lemme get this straight...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: First, this cat isn't a stray. He has an owner...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not only that, his name is actually Nyantaro?! What are the odds?!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: That's right. And I'm his owner, Inuyama.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: I never expected to meet someone who'd given him the same name.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th-Th-Th-This...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is terrible!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, Mr. Inuyama!
I had no idea that he had an owner. I ended up giving him a name and a steady diet of dried sardines...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How can I ever make up for what I've done...?!?!?!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: No, I'm actually very happy. I've been wondering why he's been heading out in such a good mood lately. Also, based on what I just heard, you saved him from the pond, is that right?

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
Nyantaro's a bit of a fraidy-cat.
Fortunately, you were there to save him. Thank you again, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: I know. If you're free, would you like to come visit my carnival...?

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
I feel I should thank you somehow.
I mean, you've been so good to Nyantaro...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, your carnival...?

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: You've noticed that there's a carnival set up nearby, yes? I'm actually the owner of it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You are...?!
We were just about to go check it out!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
Ah, perfect.
I'd like to take this opportunity to invite all of you.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: It isn't exactly the grandest of affairs, but your satisfaction is guaranteed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, but... Are you sure?
Inviting Tenma is one thing... But us?

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Yes, you're all invited. I'm grateful that you showed genuine concern for Nyantaro here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
Then, I think we have no choice but to accept your offer!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Nyantaro's brushing up against your ankles, Tenma...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. I think this means he wants to join our group.

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! You're obviously welcome to join us! We are kindred spirits, are we not...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, since when...?

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'll lead the way...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, please do!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Thank goodness they were able to find Nyantaro☆)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And getting to check out this carnival as a group sounds like a lot of fun♪)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm so happy for you, Tsukasa!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Cats, cats, cats as far as the eye can see!
What a sight to behold...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Welcome to my cat-themed carnival, everyone. I call it Meow Park!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Mizuki
rows.Line: I-It's so cute...!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All the rides, attractions and snacks are designed to look like cats...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, look! That shop's selling cat ears and hats and stuff...! They look way too cute...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, check it out. Isn't that Mikke there over in front of the big slide?! He's this carnival's mascot, so we gotta get a picture with him later...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, does the name Mikke come from “mikeneko”? He is based on a calico cat...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Haha. Anyway, I'll leave you all to it.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: I'll be walking around the carnival for the most part, so let me know if you have any questions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Shall we, Nyantaro?

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong, Nyantaro? Why are you coming over to me...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Aren't you gonna go with Mr. Inuyama?

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: He's brushing up against your legs, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Haha. I think he wants to play with you all some more. It seems you've become fast friends.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Friends...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, why don't we go around the carnival together...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's a great idea.
It'll be super fun to see everything together!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
Hehe. Go right on ahead, Nyantaro.
I hope you all have a wonderful time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you!
se_walk_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, which ride should we go on first...?

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Nyantaro's walking that way...

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
He's looking back towards us.
I think he's trying to say, “This way”...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha.
Does this mean he's gonna be our guide?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, if that's the case...
Then let's all follow him!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Show us where we should go first, Nyantaro... I mean, partner!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're upgrading him to partner just like that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, this roller coaster's so cute♪
Look at the rails! They're covered in cat paw prints!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Look at that.
I'm a little scared, but at least the design is somewhat comforting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Are you guys feeling okay?
What about you, Tsukasa? You went quiet all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
N-Nonsense! I don't feel scared at all.
Not one bit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, here comes the drop!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not... Scaaaaaaaared!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You get to ride on cats for this merry-go-round. Which should I choose...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm gonna ride the white one because it's got such an adorable bow on it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... I'll choose...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, this tabby... It looks just like Nyantaro.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, I'll ride this one...
Giddy up, partner!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You just keep making new friends at every turn, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I really wanted this plushie.
Thanks for helping me get it, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I didn't know you were so good at these kinds of shooting galleries.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, it's not so hard once you get the hang of it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But you were also really good, Akiyama.
I'm glad you got the prize you wanted...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's because you were such a great teacher! Again, thanks♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Where to next, Nyantaro?

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. It's really like he's guiding us around.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's amazing how smart he is.
He's been waiting patiently outside while we go on rides and stuff. And once we get off, he starts leading us towards the next attraction.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's also basically glued himself to Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, I always thought carnivals only had simple or lower-quality rides and attractions. The ones here are surprisingly serious...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I read online that the ones here are all handpicked and really sturdy. They've apparently had pretty much the same lineup since the carnival first opened.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In other words, these attractions have accompanied Mr. Inuyama to countless different places.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Hey, let's go on the cat merry-go-round again!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: The roller coaster was a little scary, but it ended up being really fun...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They've put smiles on the faces of so many.)

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, he's calling to us.
I think he wants us to go on the big slide next.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
Let's go, Akiyama, Nene, Airi Momoi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Again, why do you keep calling me by my full name?!
Several hours later
Meow Park Entrance

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The Ferris wheel we went on at the end was so cute! Not only did the gondolas all have cat ears on them, they were covered in paw prints inside too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and you're able to see the whole carnival from the top. I can see why it's the most popular ride!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And thanks for being such a great guide, Nyantaro.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we got to have our fill of fun thanks to you!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. We should come again sometime...!
Maybe we can ask Mr. Inuyama where they'll be touring next.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we can also use this opportunity to thank him one last time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Based on what the staff told us, he should be by the gate bidding farewell to the guests.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, that looks like him.
Mr. Inuyama!
se_run_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
Hm? Ah, there you all are.
Thank you for visiting today. Did you all have fun?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, we did!
Quite a lot of fun, in fact!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The cat designs everywhere were all so cute...!
It honestly felt like bliss...!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
I'm glad to hear that.
I did invest quite a lot of energy into this place.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, we were just talking about visiting again. Can you tell us where the next stop for your carnival is going to be...?

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: The next stop...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: I appreciate you saying that, but I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: This is actually the final stop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is your carnival's final stop...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
B-But why?
You've been able to put smiles on the faces of so many...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
Fortunately, yes.
It's a moving sight to behold.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
However, as you can see, I'm not young...
Traveling around from place to place takes its toll.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
But I'm satisfied.
I started this carnival with the dream of putting smiles on the faces of people all over.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: And I've successfully accomplished that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: People all over...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
Yes. Even today, I got to see all these guests smile and laugh.
That includes you kids.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: And I couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Mr. Inuyama...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
It is unfortunate to hear that such a wonderful carnival is going to be closing its gates... But I also believe that you've made a large number of people very happy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That obviously includes me!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Ah, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know. Would it be alright if I asked you when your final day is?

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'd like to come visit again if possible!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, we were just talking about coming back!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Haha. You did say that.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
The final day is two weeks from now.
You're all more than welcome to visit if you're free then.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Two weeks from now... We don't have practice then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm also free.
So, let's all come back together, the four of us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed! We shall return to this carnival and witness what is surely going to be a spectacular finale!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: A spectacular finale...

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meooow...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Mr. Inuyama...?

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
No, it's nothing serious.
It's just...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
If only we could do that show...
Then we'd be able to give this carnival the send-off it deserves.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Would it be possible for you to tell us more...?

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: So, to celebrate the opening of this carnival, we put on a show for the first week. The staff and I came up with it together...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: But we'd never done anything like that before in our lives. Through trial and error, we wrote a script, designed all the costumes and whatnot. It was quite an ordeal...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: That being said...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: When we actually put on the show, all that pain suddenly disappeared.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
The audience clearly enjoyed our show.
I saw the carnival guests all smiling and laughing. It was the moment I realized that this is how dreams are made.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: I'm never going to forget that sensation I felt. Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why this show means so much to you all...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Yes, and I was hoping that we could put it on one last time before the carnival closes for good... But we can't...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, why not?

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Not only were we not able to find a full copy of the script, the costumes also need repairs. Those and a few other factors brought us to the conclusion that it won't be possible.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: You might think we should simply put on a brand-new show... But only that show from our beginnings would hold any real meaning as this carnival's final spectacle.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: So, we've given up on doing one.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's so unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
I shouldn't be talking about something so negative to a group of guests.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, I was the one who asked.
More importantly...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If you don't feel comfortable with this, Mr. Inuyama, I'll understand... But would you allow me to put on this show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've actually been a cast member at an amusement park, and I was incredibly touched by your story just now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I understand what you meant when you talked about wanting to see everyone smile and not being able to forget that sensation you felt.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, if possible, I'd like to help out.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Me too...
I'd also like to lend a hand.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Like Tenma said, we made a lot of great memories here today...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've made a lot of people smile up until now, Mr. Inuyama. So, I want to make sure you're smiling wide at the finale!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
I appreciate the kind offer...
But as I just mentioned, we don't even have a full copy of the script.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: And the costumes really are in tatters...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'll do something about the script.
I can try to reconstruct the story based on everything you can remember!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: As for the costumes, I might be able to help. If you have pictures or any other references for what they used to look like, I should be able to restore them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not as good as Mizuki here, but I also know my way around a sewing machine.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... I can't help fix the costumes or anything...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I can help out as a member of the cast.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All of you...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We promise to make you and the guests all smile, Mr. Inuyama.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, please...
Would you let us do your show?

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much...
If you're willing to go this far...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
I know it's beyond unreasonable to ask people who I just met to help me with this.
But...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: If it means getting to experience that feeling again...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
Alright...
Would you help an old man make his dream come true?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In the name of putting smiles on you and all the guests, Mr. Inuyama...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We promise to make this show a success!
A few days later
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I believe we all have a copy of the script.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow, it's bound and everything...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It really feels like we're getting ready to do a show now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sorry for asking you both to also appear in the show. I know you're very busy fixing the costumes...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not a problem! I'm actually really happy about getting to do a show with you again, Tsukasa. I mean, the one we did at the chocolate factory was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Momoi, are you going to be okay? You also have your group to think about...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that won't be an issue.
The others gave me the green light after I told them about Mr. Inuyama.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They told me to go out there and do my best since they understand what I want to do.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start going over the story!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's based on the synopsis Mr. Inuyama gave us the other day, right? A feline hero protects a carnival...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. It takes place at a carnival which has a large Ferris wheel as its main attraction...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The story revolves around our hero, Nyantaro, taking part in an epic battle against a pair of mischievous cat sisters.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: An epic battle? I don't remember it being quite so dramatic...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The sisters showed up at the carnival one day and began pulling pranks on all the guests.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nyantaro brought them to justice each time, but that did nothing to deter them from coming back time and again...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, one day, the sisters come up with the most dastardly plan imaginable...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They stop the Ferris wheel, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and it saddens many of the guests since it's the carnival's main attraction.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When the sisters run off with the control switch, Nyantaro gives chase in order to get the carnival guests smiling once more...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The sisters are quick, and they don't make it easy, but Nyantaro does manage to catch them and reactivate the Ferris wheel.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The sisters finally see the error of their ways, and the guests return to smiling. The end!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, the climax sounds really exciting!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I can't wait to see how Nyantaro chases after those sisters!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, by the way, Mr. Inuyama played the lead during his carnival's opening celebration.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hang on a second... Do you think the Nyantaro in this show is based off the real Nyantaro?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, they apparently put on this show around twenty years ago...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means Nyantaro was named after the hero from this story.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see...
In other words, he's the embodiment of some really precious memories.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mr. Inuyama must've loved this show a lot...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Nod*
And that's a powerful source of motivation!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Definitely! We've gotta make this the best show ever!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's do our best!
What do you need us to do next, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, we need to decide roles now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Starting with Nyantaro.
Several minutes later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, we all have our roles now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The protagonist, Nyantaro, will be played by... Me, Tsukasa Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: As for the cat sisters, Airi will play the older one and Kusanagi will play the younger one.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to working with you, Kusanagi! I can't wait for you to teach me more about acting like you did during Shibu Schools Fest!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I'm also looking forward to working with you...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And you'll be playing one of the carnival's guests, Akiyama. Although, it is a tad unfortunate that you're going to be all by yourself...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: My plan's to pull out all the stops and really act out having a fun day, but I feel like I can only do so much on my own...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
If only we had at least one more person.
Isn't there anyone we can ask...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good question.
Unfortunately, Rui and Emu are busy that day, and I'm not sure who else could help us...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, I think I know just the person to ask...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When I told the others in my group about this, Minori's eyes lit up and she said, “Doing a show with them sounds like so much fun!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She even said that she wants to help out in any way she can, so we could have her join the cast.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Hanasato, you say?!
She's sort of my dance student...
It'd be great to have her on board!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'd also love to work with Minori!
If anything, I should be the one asking her to join us since she's my favorite idol...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'll try asking her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehehe. This is gonna be so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That should take care of our casting problem. What else do we need to check up on...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come to think of it, how are the costumes coming along? I've been fixing the accessories and stuff bit by bit...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm working on the hero's costume right now. It was pretty beat up, but I should be able to get it back in shape!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: As for the sisters, their cat ears and a couple other accessories were all that was left. We sorta have to use clothes you and Kusanagi already have for the outfits.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To compensate, I'm gonna make everything look really cute by attaching a bunch of ribbons and stuff! So, stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. I can't wait to see what you make!
Also, we should meet up to work on costume stuff together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I'm glad to hear that we all seem to know what to do.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. But we only have a week and change until the final day...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know. How about a toast to celebrate us entering the preparation phase of our show?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, does that need a toast...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! We need to keep ourselves motivated!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I already finished my drink...
But still, it might be a good way to help us feel more like a team.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do it♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, raise your glasses, you three.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This may be a short show, but we don't have much time to practice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As challenging as this endeavor is going to be, let's make sure our show puts smiles on the faces of Mr. Inuyama and all the guests! Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Mizuki & Nene
rows.Line: Cheers!
Early morning
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Good morning!
Starting today, Minori Hanasato will be joining you guys for practice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I already went for a run, so I'm all warmed up and ready to go!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow, Minori's shining like the sun as always today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How can anyone sound so cheerful at six in the morning...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Pretty incredible, right?
I was barely able to get out of my bed...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah hah! I like your energy, Hanasato! I hope you'll be able to make good use of it during the show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I promise to do my very best!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Now then, let's start practicing...!
se_run_women_003_1
se_run_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Pass it this way, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
Here it goes...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes, got it...!
We're getting pretty good at running while tossing these props to each other.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now we just need a little something extra to really draw the audience's attention...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, in that case... It might be good for us to throw in a quick dance. Maybe something catlike to fit our characters...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, that's a great idea!
I'm really good at dancing, so we can choreograph something together!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, we're supposed to interact with the audience during the show. What can we say to get the crowd really into it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm... Oh, I know.
During the scene where we're all supposed to cheer for Nyantaro, what if we said...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “Hey, why don't we all show Nyantaro our support? Yes, I'm talking to you!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We can ask each member of the audience for their help...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's such an amazing idea...!!
They're sure to get on board if you ask them, Minori! Even now, that felt like a super special treat...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm glad you liked it!
Then, we could also...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, this hero costume...!
It fits like an absolute dream!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thank goodness.
Do you think you'll be able to move around okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, this is incredible!
And when I put on this cape...
I feel even more like a superhero! What an exhilarating sensation...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I'm going to wear this during practice today! To start, I'll warm up with a lap of the park...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: W-Wait, you're gonna stick out like a sore thumb! Also, what if you end up ripping the stitches...?!
The day before the show
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph... Hah...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What do you think, Miku?
That was the pose I'm going to strike during the climax...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hmm... That was cool, but I feel like you need to look a lot stronger and tougher since it's your last pose!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Stronger, eh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, I'll keep trying.
After all, this is the scene where peace is brought back to the carnival.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for the advice. I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. You're welcome☆>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Break a leg tomorrow, Tsukasa!
I'll be cheering for you all sneakily♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, you won't be disappointed!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That reminds me. I came up with twenty catlike hero poses for when we're asked to take pictures following the show! And I have a good feeling about all of them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For example, this one!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow, cute and cool at the same time☆>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Can you show me some of your other poses?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I've also come up with...
The day of the show
Meow Park

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, as expected of the last day, there's a huge number of guests here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Now I'm even more excited about our show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
And we gotta succeed to make sure all the practice we did doesn't go to waste...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's almost time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I placed quite a burden on all of you...
But now we just need to go out there and give it everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's make it so Mr. Inuyama and the guests are all smiling at the end!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Mizuki, Minori & Nene
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Nyantaro.
Does this mean you're also excited about the show?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, he's wearing a collar with a little bow!
Did he get dressed up for today?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Probably because it's the final day.
It must be his way of honoring this carnival.

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're a member of the audience for today's show, so don't look away for a second...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because we're going to give this carnival a finale like no other!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, the curtains go up soon.
Let's take our stations and...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama's Voice
rows.Line:
What...?!
Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Unfortunately...
I'm so sorry. We're trying to figure out what happened as quickly as we can...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That looks like Mr. Inuyama talking to that staff member over by the Ferris wheel. They sound really worried...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Something may've happened...
It might affect the show, so we should go over and see what the trouble is.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay...!
se_run_women_003_4

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Mr. Inuyama!

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Hm? Ah, Tenma, all of you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We overheard a part of your conversation just now. Did something happen...?

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: A-Ah... The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: We have to stop the Ferris wheel.
In Front of the Ferris Wheel

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You have to stop it...?

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Yes, we've decided to stop and inspect it since it seems to be acting up a bit.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: But figuring out the cause may take some time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Hey, it looks like the Ferris wheel is down for repairs...

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
Aww, I was really looking forward to going on it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: Our hands are tied since we must put safety first...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: That being said... I feel absolutely terrible about disappointing the guests like this during the last day...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Mr. Inuyama...

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line:
But I'm satisfied.
I started this carnival with the dream of putting smiles on the faces of people all over.

rows.Speaker: Inuyama
rows.Line: And I've successfully accomplished that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(This place means everything to Mr. Inuyama...
It's designed to make all those who attend smile and laugh.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And now both he and his guests are going to spend their final day here frowning...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything we can do...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Isn't there a way we can make it so everybody here goes home smiling?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is all I can conjure up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Mr. Inuyama, all of you...
Would you mind listening for a minute?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have an idea.
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: It's too bad, but we'll just have to go on something else. What about that merry-go-round? Doesn't riding cats sound like fun?

rows.Line: We wanna go on the Ferris wheel!
